children: Corning reported third-quarter 2026 core sales of $5.08 billion, up 19% year over year, and core diluted EPS of $0.91, up 36%. Core gross and operating margins expanded, while GAAP sales were $4.86 billion and GAAP diluted EPS was $0.78. For the fourth quarter, the company expects core sales of $5.2 billion to $5.3 billion and core EPS of $0.96 to $1.00.
Financial Highlights
Core sales:
$5.081 billion, up 19% year over year; GAAP net sales were $4.855 billion.
Core gross profit:
$2.059 billion, with a core gross margin of 40.5%, up 150 basis points year over year. GAAP gross margin was 37.3%.
Core operating income:
$1.152 billion, with a core operating margin of 22.7%, up 310 basis points year over year. GAAP operating income was $911 million.
Core net income and adjusted diluted EPS:
$795 million and $0.91, respectively. GAAP net income attributable to Corning was $680 million, and GAAP diluted EPS was $0.78.
Cash flow:
GAAP operating cash flow was $1.061 billion, and adjusted free cash flow was $661 million.
Business Highlights
Optical Communications:
Sales rose 44% year over year. Enterprise Networks sales grew 84%, and Gen AI product sales more than doubled year over year.
Solar:

Production continued to ramp, though more slowly than anticipated. Corning said improving productivity should support increased output and profitability, and that U.S. trade action under Section 232 is improving the pricing environment and demand for U.S.-made solar products.
Glass Innovations:
The segment’s “More Corning” content strategy continued to drive adoption of Corning innovations and outperform TV, notebook, and smartphone markets, which faced pressure from memory pricing.
Customer agreements:
Corning secured four long-term, multibillion-dollar customer agreements during the quarter, including agreements with Verizon and AT&T.
Growth plan:
Management said the acceleration outlined in its “20-30-40” Springboard Plan has begun. The plan targets doubling the annualized sales run rate from $20 billion to $40 billion by the end of 2030.
